title: Clinical Pharmacology
summary: Bounded, repeatable workflows a clinical pharmacologist owns or reviews across the document spine — protocols, study reports, evidence packages, submission summaries and labelling content. Every skill reviews, reconciles, structures or flags; qualified humans decide, approve, sign off and submit.

skills.title: CSR PK Consistency Review
skills.workflow: Review PK content across the CSR synopsis, body, tables, figures and permitted source outputs, then produce a source-linked discrepancy register and QC memo for qualified human resolution.
never: reruns NCA or any other analysis
decides which conflicting scientific value is correct

skills.title: Protocol PK Section Review
skills.workflow: Review clinical pharmacology and PK protocol sections and their stated assumptions.
skills.gate: Activation separation against review-csr-pk-consistency must pass before release. The research names this pair as its residual architectural risk.
skills.evidence_gap: No synthetic fixture, eval suite or benchmark run. Activation separation against review-csr-pk-consistency untested.

skills.title: DDI Evidence Review
skills.workflow: Review DDI evidence, study design, analysis, interpretation and gaps.
skills.gate: Must cite and defer to licensed interaction databases, never replicate them. Replication of curated DDI databases is an excluded use.
skills.evidence_gap: No synthetic fixture, eval suite or benchmark run. M12 decision-tree checker not implemented.

skills.title: Cross-Document Fact Reconciliation
skills.workflow: Reconcile clinical pharmacology facts across the programme document spine.
skills.gate: Consumes the shared cross-document consistency tool in programme mode. Ships only after that engine is proven in document mode by review-csr-pk-consistency.
skills.evidence_gap: No synthetic fixture, eval suite or benchmark run. T05 programme mode not exercised against a multi-document thread.

skills.title: Bioanalytical Report Review
skills.workflow: Review bioanalytical report content relevant to PK interpretation.
skills.evidence_gap: No fixture or evals. Tier C: the research withheld a card because the reviewable surface reduces to the shared ICH M10 rubric.

skills.title: NCA Output Verification
skills.workflow: Verify NCA outputs, units, derivations and internal consistency.
skills.gate: Reviewer-side only. The performer-versus-reviewer split varies by company and is a configurable input, never an assumed organisational model.
skills.evidence_gap: No synthetic fixture, eval suite or benchmark run. Activation separation against review-csr-pk-consistency and review-bioanalytical-report untested.

skills.title: Development Plan Gap Assessment
skills.workflow: Assess a clinical pharmacology development plan for evidence and study gaps.
skills.gate: The merge of plan-gap and evidence-gap assessment into one skill is an unvalidated assumption. Practitioner validation may split it back apart.
skills.evidence_gap: No synthetic fixture, eval suite or benchmark run. The plan-gap / evidence-gap merge remains an unvalidated assumption.

skills.title: Briefing Package Content
skills.workflow: Prepare and review clinical pharmacology briefing-package content and open questions.
skills.gate: Commitment boundary must be explicit; the skill prepares, it never commits.
skills.evidence_gap: No synthetic fixture, eval suite or benchmark run.

skills.title: Agency Question Evidence Map
skills.workflow: Map an authority question to evidence, gaps, owners and a reviewed response draft.
skills.gate: States no numeric turnaround norm — the commonly cited figure is practice-only and was not evidenced.
skills.evidence_gap: No synthetic fixture, eval suite or benchmark run.

skills.title: CTD 2.7.2 Content Review
skills.hold_reason: Ownership gate. CTD 2.7.2 authorship by clinical pharmacology is a practice convention assigned by no FDA, EMA or ICH text. The accountable owner must be a configurable input, validated against at least two documented organisational models before release.
skills.evidence_gap: No fixture or evals. OWNERSHIP GATE open: 2.7.2 authorship is a practice convention assigned by no FDA, EMA or ICH text; owner-configurability not validated against two documented organisational models.

skills.title: USPI Section 12 Content Review
skills.hold_reason: Legally sensitive. Label text is binding. Deliberately scoped as a review contract rather than an authoring one; released only after review-only skills have demonstrated governance in practice.
skills.evidence_gap: No fixture or evals. LEGALLY SENSITIVE: label text is binding. Review-only contract not yet reviewed by a qualified labelling reviewer.

skills.title: FIH Dose Rationale Review
skills.hold_reason: Higher risk. Safety-critical IND gate with dose adjacency. Review-only framing; the skill never derives or proposes a starting dose.
skills.evidence_gap: No fixture or evals. HIGHER-RISK, dose-adjacent. Hardened review gate not validated with a practitioner.

skills.title: Study Conduct PK Review
skills.hold_reason: Risk veto recorded in the research scoring. Real-time, blinding-constrained and safety-critical committee work.
skills.evidence_gap: No fixture or evals. RISK VETO recorded in the research scoring (55.0), the lowest-scored candidate. Scope restricted to review of an already-assembled package.

skills.title: Dose Justification Evidence
skills.hold_reason: Risk veto recorded in the research scoring. Output sits one step from a registration-dose decision; humans must own the dose call.
skills.evidence_gap: No fixture or evals. RISK VETO recorded in the research scoring (62.5) — output sits one step from a registration-dose decision.

skills.title: Model Analysis Deliverable Review
skills.defer_reason: Proposed for Pharmacometrics primary ownership — the modelling function owns the workflow outcome. Its disposition belongs to the commissioned Pharmacometrics research, not to this collection.
skills.evidence_gap: No fixture or evals. Tier C: proposed for PHARMACOMETRICS primary ownership; collection assignment provisional pending the returning PMx research. Activation against verify-nca-outputs and review-ctd-272-content untested.

excluded.reason: Outside the public product boundary; patient-specific risk.
Dose selection, escalation and stopping belong to human committees.
Model execution is pharmacometrics work, not a skill capability.
Curated interaction databases are licensed; cite and defer, never replicate.
No skill in this library carries a GxP qualification or any form of clinical validation.
